requested_transformation.evidence: Hem shortened and garment fitted, but matching fabric joined by a dark waist band still reads as a fitted dress; separate top and skirt are not visually established.

identity_preservation.evidence: Recognizable facial/hair appearance, but eyes, facial proportions and texture are noticeably redrawn.

body_shape_preservation.evidence: Waist/hip silhouette becomes markedly more fitted; original loose dress prevents exact underlying-body comparison.

anatomy_preservation.evidence: All originally visible limbs retained and generally plausible; hand and leg contours soften.

pose_preservation.evidence: Hand-on-hip arrangement retained, but shoulder/hip stance and feet positions shift noticeably.

unrelated_clothing_preservation.evidence: No separate unrelated clothing item was visible to preserve; original bare feet remain bare.

accessory_preservation.evidence: Ponytail and hair tie retained; foot tattoo/detail is softened.

camera_and_framing_preservation.evidence: 680x1024 frame and pre-existing bottom-edge foot crop retained; no canvas extension.

lighting_and_background_preservation.evidence: Same room and furniture remain, but lamp, table, thermostat and upholstery details are redrawn and softened.

instruction_adherence.evidence: Does not convincingly satisfy the explicit visibly-distinct two-piece requirement or no-dress instruction.

artifact_severity.evidence: Noticeable blur and loss of fine detail across face, hands and room; no severe duplicated/missing anatomy.

overall_usability.evidence: Fails requested garment distinction despite producing a plausible fitted short garment.

decision_rule: Any hard-fail condition fails the case regardless of scores. Record each dimension independently; do not conceal a failure in an average. Final usability requires visual review.

reason: Unmasked native image editing; evaluate semantic preservation rather than deterministic pixel identity.
operation_acceptance: Fitted top and separate short miniskirt with visible separation; no dress, bodysuit or one-piece. Preserve existing lower-edge crop.
source_specific_limitations: Feet/toes meet the lower border. This is approved only for dress editing; preserve the existing crop and do not reconstruct feet.
reviewer: Codex visual assessment; not a user acceptance decision
review_method: Full source/native output inspection and side-by-side review at native or readable resolution. Scores are subjective rubric judgments, not biometric measurements.
